metadata.title: ConfigStream System Architecture Topology
metadata.description: Comprehensive, AST-verified structural graph mapping all 52 architectural nodes, 78 protocol edges, and 12 execution flows across ConfigStream core engine, Go tester, CI matrix, distribution mirrors, and frontend PWA client.

nodes.name: External Proxy Sources
nodes.description: External third-party Git repositories, raw HTTP endpoints, and Telegram channels providing raw proxy configurations (Vmess, Vless, Trojan, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2, TUIC).

nodes.name: Cloudflare WARP Infrastructure
nodes.description: Cloudflare WARP edge registration endpoints (v4/v6) and clean IP pools queried for client key exchange, device registration, and Wireguard/Masque tunneling.

nodes.name: Network Validation Endpoints
nodes.description: High-availability HTTP/204 verification targets (e.g. Google generate_204, Cloudflare cdn-cgi trace, Yandex) used to measure proxy latency, handshake integrity, and captive portal evasion.

nodes.name: sing-box Native Core Engine
nodes.description: Embedded sing-box (v1.13+) Go networking core with uTLS, Reality, ECH, and Wireguard drivers embedded directly inside the Go batch tester process.

nodes.name: Cloudflare Edge Worker Bridge
nodes.description: Edge reverse proxy and failover routing layer distributing static artifacts and API updates to blocked regions via Cloudflare Global Anycast.

nodes.name: Multi-Cloud Mirror Publishers
nodes.description: Automated deployment connectors publishing verified releases across GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, HuggingFace Spaces, IPFS, Google Drive, and Telegram.

nodes.name: ConfigStream CLI Gateway
nodes.description: Unified CLI command entry point providing pipeline invocation ('run', 'merge', 'clean', 'bot', 'serve', 'diagnose') with strict argument parsing and signal handling.

nodes.name: Telegram Bot Long-Polling Daemon
nodes.description: Interactive Telegram bot providing authorized users with on-demand WARP device provisioning, latest mirror URLs, network status diagnostics, and node filtering.

nodes.name: CI Matrix Shard Orchestrator
nodes.description: GitHub Actions workflow coordinator executing matrix test shards concurrently, caching intermediate SQLite state, and triggering artifact consolidation.

nodes.name: Dynamic Matrix Resharder
nodes.description: P95 execution latency profiler analyzing historical source performance from 'source_timing.jsonl' to balance matrix shards and prevent job stragglers.

nodes.name: Matrix Shard Consolidation Worker
nodes.description: Aggregator script merging partitioned SQLite test caches, deduplicating cross-shard proxy pools, and generating master output bundles.

nodes.name: Source Admission Gatekeeper
nodes.description: Validates and normalizes candidate source locators against cryptographic commit pinning, domain allow-lists, and protocol admission policies.

nodes.name: GitHub Blob Snapshot Adapter
nodes.description: Fetches commit-pinned source repositories and snapshots via GitHub REST/GraphQL raw blobs with ETag verification and rate-limit backoff.

nodes.name: Source Policy Enforcer
nodes.description: Applies per-source rate limits, byte caps, license checks, and freshness TTLs to prevent source poisoning and pipeline exhaustion.

nodes.name: Source Quality & Circuit Breaker
nodes.description: Monitors per-source yield, error rates, and consecutive failure counts, tripping circuit breakers for degraded or compromised feeds.

nodes.name: Async Ingestion Producer
nodes.description: Asynchronous stream producer iterating admitted source URLs, creating batch fetch requests, and managing feed discovery concurrency.

nodes.name: Resilient HTTP/TLS Fetcher
nodes.description: High-concurrency async HTTP fetcher with custom uTLS fingerprinted handshakes, exponential retry policies, and SSL context rotation.

nodes.name: Bounded Async Work Queue
nodes.description: In-memory backpressure-controlled asyncio priority queue buffering fetched proxy candidates between producer and consumer pool.

nodes.name: Pipeline Event Bus & Telemetry
nodes.description: Pub/sub event bus streaming pipeline telemetry (item progress, batch completion, error events, stage transitions) to collectors.

nodes.name: Consumer Worker Pool
nodes.description: Multi-coroutine processing pool executing the candidate lifecycle: extraction, security sanitization, test dispatch, revival, and geo tagging.

nodes.name: Universal Protocol Parser
nodes.description: Extracts and normalizes proxy link formats (vmess://, vless://, trojan://, ss://, ssr://, hy2://, tuic://, wireguard://) into unified Proxy models.

nodes.name: Security & SSRF Validator
nodes.description: Multi-pass security filter verifying IP literal bounds, RFC1918 private subnet exclusions, port boundaries, protocol validity, and Bloom deduplication.

nodes.name: Honeypot & Censorship Probe Detector
nodes.description: Analyzes DNS signatures, known ISP monitoring honeypot IP ranges, and circular proxy patterns to prevent hostile traffic entrapment.

nodes.name: Dynamic CIDR/ASN Blocklist
nodes.description: Manages thread-safe dynamic IP/CIDR blocklists and malicious autonomous system numbers (ASNs) with atomic reload locks.

nodes.name: Go Subprocess Batch Tester
nodes.description: High-performance Go daemon running sing-box data-plane network dials, TLS handshakes, HTTP/204 probes, and uTLS fingerprints via NDJSON IPC.

nodes.name: Python Fallback Test Runner
nodes.description: Pure Python fallback tester utilizing socket connection probes and urllib when the Go binary is unavailable or running on constrained environments.

nodes.name: Smart Retest Scheduler
nodes.description: Calculates exponential backoff and adaptive retest intervals based on past reliability, latency stability, and historic uptime tiers.

nodes.name: Proxy Washer & Shielding Engine
nodes.description: Encapsulates proxy traffic inside Cloudflare WARP/Masque tunnels and applies 'Lazarus Pit' shielding to revive dead outbound nodes.

nodes.name: Vwarp Masque Daemon Manager
nodes.description: Spawns and manages local high-speed Vwarp tunnel daemons implementing Cloudflare Masque (HTTP/3) transport layers.

nodes.name: Cloudflare Clean IP Scanner
nodes.description: Probes Cloudflare edge IP subnets for unblocked endpoints with low packet loss, minimal latency, and active WARP handshake support.

nodes.name: Multi-Hop Smart Chain Router
nodes.description: Generates optimal multi-hop proxy chains (e.g. Entry Node in Iran -> Transit Node in Europe -> Exit Node in US) for censorship circumvention.

nodes.name: Steganographic Payload Encoder
nodes.description: Encodes encrypted proxy bundles into PNG pixel matrices using Paeth predictors and CRC32 chunks for covert distribution over image CDNs.

nodes.name: GeoIP & ASN Resolution Engine
nodes.description: Enriches verified nodes with ISO country codes, flags, city names, and ISP/ASN descriptors from MaxMind GeoLite2 databases.

nodes.name: Multi-Objective Pareto Sorter
nodes.description: Ranks verified proxies using non-dominated Pareto sorting balancing latency, reliability, packet stability, and geographical diversity.

nodes.name: Deduplication & Ranking Stage
nodes.description: Final consolidation stage removing duplicate endpoint configurations and sorting proxies into categorized tier subsets.

nodes.name: Client Output Matrix Generator
nodes.description: Renders verified datasets into client formats (sing-box JSON, Clash YAML, V2Ray URI lists, CSV, Base64, and country-sharded splits).

nodes.name: Ed25519 Cryptographic Signer
nodes.description: Generates asymmetric Ed25519 cryptographic signatures for output manifests with 300s validity envelopes and NTP skew tolerances.

nodes.name: Fail-Closed Publication Gate
nodes.description: Security gate auditing the release directory before deployment, verifying sha256 checksums and ensuring no internal SQLite databases or secrets leak.

nodes.name: MaxMind GeoLite2 Database
nodes.description: Local MMDB binary database (Country + ASN) queried with zero network latency for IP geographical enrichment.

nodes.name: Source Quality SQLite Database
nodes.description: Persistent SQLite database storing source reliability scores, crawl timestamps, domain error rates, and yield metrics.

nodes.name: Proxy History SQLite Database
nodes.description: Historical SQLite database tracking individual proxy uptime lifetimes, first/last seen timestamps, and latency drift curves.

nodes.name: Test Results Cache Database
nodes.description: SQLite cache storing recent proxy test outcomes, preventing redundant re-probing of stable nodes within active cooldown windows.

nodes.name: Public Release Artifact Store
nodes.description: Filesystem directory containing finalized, signed, and validated distribution bundles ('/public/' or '/dist/').

nodes.name: FastAPI Web & Subscription Server
nodes.description: High-performance async web server serving REST endpoints, dynamic subscription routes, differential delta APIs, and WebSockets.

nodes.name: WebSocket Live Broadcast Broker
nodes.description: WebSocket connection manager broadcasting real-time UPDATE_AVAILABLE events to connected dashboard clients upon release updates.

nodes.name: Differential Delta API Engine
nodes.description: Computes incremental JSON deltas between consecutive proxy generations, reducing mobile client bandwidth by up to 94%.

nodes.name: Runtime Telemetry & Health Monitor
nodes.description: Continuous health evaluation service monitoring SQLite integrity, disk budgets, memory usage, and API response percentiles.

nodes.name: ConfigStream PWA Dashboard
nodes.description: Modern responsive single-page progressive web application offering interactive proxy filtering, QR export, live latency testing, and dark mode.

nodes.name: Client Cache & Offline Coordinator
nodes.description: Client-side IndexedDB and ServiceWorker cache manager enabling instant offline load and atomic differential dataset patching.

nodes.name: Client WebAssembly Verifier
nodes.description: Compiled Go WebAssembly module running in a WebWorker to perform zero-trust cryptographic signature verification directly inside the user's browser.

nodes.name: Transparency Evidence Explorer
nodes.description: In-browser inspection tool allowing users to examine raw signature proofs, build SHA manifests, reproducibility logs, and Git supply chain data.

nodes.name: BYOW Profile Assembler
nodes.description: Interactive 'Bring Your Own WARP' configuration builder generating custom Wireguard/Masque profiles with user-provided Cloudflare credentials.

flows.name: 1. Source Admission & Ingestion Pipeline
flows.description: Validates source admission policies, fetches commit-pinned snapshots, applies rate-limits, and feeds the async ingestion queue.

steps.action: Submit source URLs for admission policy check
Fetch commit-pinned Git tree and raw blobs
Enforce byte caps, license validity, and rate limits
Admitted source objects passed into producer loop
Dispatch concurrent async HTTP/TLS fetchers
Enqueue fetched raw proxy candidate text with backpressure

flows.name: 2. Producer-Consumer Work Queue Dispatch
flows.description: Orchestrates backpressure-controlled item streaming between producer coroutines and the consumer worker pool.

steps.action: Consumer pulls raw batch items for parsing
Extract and deserialize proxy configurations
Multi-pass security validation and Bloom filter dedupe
Filter out malicious CIDRs and blacklisted ASNs

flows.name: 3. Validation, Probing & Revival Cycle
flows.description: Screens proxy candidates against test cache, performs adaptive scheduling, dispatches batch testing, and updates quality stores.

steps.action: Query retest scheduler for adaptive cooldown check
Check test result cache hit
Dispatch test batch to Go batch tester daemon
Receive test results and latency metrics
Update cache with fresh test outcomes
Record proxy lifetime and latency stability curves

flows.name: 4. Go Tester NDJSON RPC Cycle
flows.description: High-performance IPC cycle: binary identity verification, persistent daemon spawn, NDJSON RPC, and sing-box core probing.

steps.action: Spawn daemon with sha256 binary verification
Write batch NDJSON requests over stdin
Construct sing-box box instance and DialContext
Execute HTTP generate_204 probe via proxy outbound
Stream test results over stdout

flows.name: 5. WARP Clean IP Scanning & Key Provisioning
flows.description: Scans Cloudflare edge subnets for responsive endpoints and registers fresh WARP devices with zero-trust key exchange.

steps.action: Probe Cloudflare Anycast subnets for low latency
Provide clean IP list to proxy washer
Register fresh WARP accounts and keys

flows.name: 6. Washing, Shielding & Smart Chaining
flows.description: Launders proxies through WARP tunnels, revives dead nodes via Lazarus Pit, and constructs multi-hop routing chains.

steps.action: Launder working proxies via WARP encapsulation
Apply Lazarus-Pit shielding to failed proxies
Route traffic through local Vwarp Masque daemon
Assemble multi-hop circumvention chains
Pack covert payload into PNG pixel matrices

flows.name: 7. Multi-Objective Pareto Scoring & Dedup
flows.description: Performs Pareto optimization balancing latency, reliability, packet stability, and geographical diversity.

steps.action: Resolve IP location and ASN details
Query MaxMind GeoLite2 MMDB
Score proxies along Pareto efficiency frontier
Deduplicate and group proxies into priority tiers

flows.name: 8. Dashboard Live WebSocket Update Cycle
flows.description: Broadcasts update notifications over WebSockets and performs differential client-side delta sync.

steps.action: Notify backend server of completed pipeline run
Trigger WebSocket manager broadcast
Push WebSocket event to active dashboard clients
Fetch differential delta from base version hash
Compute delta against previous generation
Return differential update payload
Patch IndexedDB cache with merged dataset

flows.name: 9. Telegram Bot Command & Account Cycle
flows.description: Processes interactive user commands for on-demand Cloudflare WARP account generation and release retrieval.

steps.action: Spawn bot long-polling worker via CLI
/warp command executes on-demand account creation
/mirror command retrieves latest signed release URLs

flows.name: 10. Dynamic CI Matrix Sharding & Rebalancing
flows.description: Calculates P95 job durations to dynamically rebalance GitHub Actions matrix partitions, preventing stragglers.

steps.action: Read source_timing.jsonl to calculate P95 durations
Emit balanced matrix configuration for runner jobs
Launch parallel shard runner jobs

flows.name: 11. Consolidation, Signing & Multi-Cloud Publishing
flows.description: Aggregates shard outputs, computes Ed25519 signatures, runs publication gatekeeper, and deploys to multi-cloud mirrors.

steps.action: Download all shard SQLite databases and merge
Generate consolidated master release bundles
Submit release manifest for Ed25519 signature
Write sealed manifest.json.sig to release directory
Audit public directory against secret leak contract
Deploy verified release to GitHub Pages & mirrors

flows.name: 12. Client-Side Cryptographic Attestation & BYOW
flows.description: In-browser zero-trust cryptographic verification of release signatures via Go WebAssembly and custom WARP assembly.

steps.action: Fetch latest proxies.json and manifest.json.sig
Send manifest and public key SPKI to WebWorker
Execute Ed25519 verification in Go WebAssembly
Render cryptographic transparency proof to user
Allow user to assemble custom Wireguard/Masque profile
